about_the_game:
Writer Tycoon Demo

Hey there — I’m a solo developer working on Writer Tycoon, a chill writing life simulator where you start out broke in a tiny studio apartment, trying to make it as an author.

In this game, you plan your books, write short creative prompts, edit them with focus choices, and see how well they perform.

  • You’ll level up your writing skills, gain fans, unlock research like marketing and book sequels, and slowly build your career one book at a time.

  • What’s in the coming demo:

  • Plan, write, and edit books across genres like sci-fi, romance, fantasy, and more

  • Each book is built from short prompts — your creativity matters

  • Watch reviews roll in and try to hit that elusive 10/10 score

  • Earn research points to unlock things like better marketing and phase control

  • Upgrade your setup and customize your little writing space

  • Write sequels to your best hits and grow your fanbase

This demo shows just a slice of what I’m working on. If you like the vibe, consider wishlisting Writer Tycoon on Steam. It helps a ton and keeps me going. Thanks for checking it out.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a writing tycoon/simulator in which the player can physically input text to write his book. The player can write whatever he wants, even mature content, sexual content, whatever he desires. Of course, there is a character limit to this of 50 characters. So the player cannot go too far if he chooses to do so in this inappropriate direction.
Also there is jokingly a humorous option for an in-game activity to visit sexual workers so that the player boosts his creativity resource. Of course everything is just panels and text, no sexual content or explicit content is viewed by the player.
